mapper.select: SELECT id, assignment_id, file_name, file_url, file_size, file_type, uploaded_by, created_at FROM assignment_files WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, assignment_id, file_name, file_url, file_size, file_type, uploaded_by, created_at FROM assignment_files WHERE assignment_id = #{assignmentId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO assignment_files ( assignment_id, file_name, file_url, file_size, file_type, uploaded_by ) VALUES ( #{assignmentId}, #{fileName}, #{fileUrl}, #{fileSize}, #{fileType}, #{uploadedBy} )
